The in-game action has a side-scrolling view and close ball control. The game is tolerant of tough tackles, as these are usually successful and rarely result in a foul. You can swerve, chip and head the ball in any direction.

140704.overview:
In Germ Crazy, you play the part of a fledgling surgeon who must protect his patient from a debilitating, flesh-eating virus. The disease must be stopped by whatever means necessary; whether by antibody injections, black market drugs, amputation, or all-out germ warfare. Just be sure that your patient doesn't suffer too much surgical abuse or else he will be greeted by Mr. Grim Reaper himself. On the flipside, being too careful may result in the rapid spreading of this hideous mutant virus, and the poor victim will literally rot away until all that remains is a skeleton!

The gameplay is complex and unique, and resembles a more biological version of Sim City. There are six levels of difficulty, but even at the easiest level, Germ Crazy is a difficult game to master. The subject matter, although undeniably grim, is tempered with a sadistic sense of humor throughout.

140705.overview:
Ghost Battle is one of the earlier games by the German company Thalion Software. Spanning five short yet difficult worlds, the game borrows its visual style heavily from its better-known contemporaries like Shadow of the Beast and Ghosts 'n' Goblins.

A simple arcade-style action game with some rudimentary adventuring and timing based puzzles thrown in, Ghost Battle casts you as a nameless hero on a quest to rescue his, yet again, nameless girlfriend from a nameless bad guy. Enemies have a horror look and feel to them - ghouls and disembodied heads for example. Initially our hero is armed with rocks, but extra weapons can be collected for specific tasks such as the bosses who end each level.

140708.overview:
The plot of Golden Eagle is a basic one: the evil priest Nahmur stole the Golden Eagle, severed it into five parts and hid them in the city. The player controls a special agent with the order (the employees are mutants) to find said parts.

So the player walks through the levels while shooting all opposition. There are also some basic puzzles to solve (collecting an item at one place and using it at another or switch puzzles) and safes to open (either with found codes or by using special equipment) in order to find the eagle parts. There are also some traps to avoid.

Besides walking and moving, the protagonist can jump and duck. All other actions like crawling can only be performed in certain places. Using terminals reveal useful information in the form of messages or a map for easier orientation. Other terminals offer the possibility to play a completely optional game of Reversi.

140709.overview:
Every aspect of the famous horse race, held over the daunting hurdles course at Aintree in Liverpool every April, is recreated here. Before each race you can place bets on up to five horses, with the odds calculated realistically, even taking betting tax into account. When choosing which horses to back, and which one to actually ride, you must consider the 'going' (what condition the ground surface is in) and which horses are likely to suit your style.

Once the race is underway you must direct the horse left and right (weaving across other horses can cause disqualification in the post-race Steward's Enquiry), jump at the right time to clear each hurdle, and crack the whip to speed up the horse. During the race you will be told how many horses are still running, as well as your own position and the identity of the leader.

140710.overview:
A motorcycle racing game recreating the now-defunct 80cc world motorcycle racing championship. It was licensed around Spanish ace Jorge Martinez 'Aspar', and your (and his) racing rivals including future 500cc World Champion Alex Criville.

The game features a full practice mode as well as qualifying and races. There are only 8 computer bikes, although the real life championship points system is used, meaning that the penalty for not finishing is bigger than in real life, especially as you only have 5 bikes to last the season. The game is viewed from overhead, and the controls are, unusually, direction based, so to take a straight which (in the overhead view) involves going up and to the right, you must push the joystick in that direction.

140808.overview:
The 1992 olympic games took place in Barcelona, Spain, and the corresponding computer game came from Ocean: The Games '92 - España. The sports simulation boasts an impressive variety of diciplines, divided into three sections:

Track and Field: running, relay, hurdles, steeplechase, discus, shot putt, hammer throw, javelin, long jump, triple jump, high jump, pole vault;
Water Sports: free style, breast stroke, back stroke, butterfly, relay, diving;
Fighting: boxing, wrestling, judo, fencing.

Eliminating the different distances in single events (such as 100m, 200m, 400m and 800m freestyle), though, The Games' "over 30 events" melt down to 22; and counting only those which differ to some degree in their execution, it boils down to six: running, throwing, jumping, swimming, diving and fighting.

The Games '92 is divided in three parts: During preparation time, manage and train twelve athletes by sentencing them to gym time and daily practice. Game time advances with each action until the olympic games begin.
In pactice, heats and finals, you take control of your athletes and drive them to peak performances through rhythmical tapping of the cursor keys, and the occasional press of the space bar.
In the database section, you can read up on previous games and winning athletes, and take a look at Barcelona location maps.

141410.overview:
A complete clone of Bank Panic (West Bank). You are the hero John Brayn with the order to protect the bank of Laramie. There are 12 doors through which bandits or innocents could appear. Shoot the bandits before they shoot you, and don't shoot the innocents.

There are gold coins to win if you shoot at them, but this is not always easy because some innocents have them in hand; so take care, good aim and good luck.

141876.overview:
Galaxy Force II is an expanded version of Galaxy Force. It adds two additional levels, the old levels are revised (expanded and re-balanced) and the four missiles can be fired with a single button press.

You are strapped into a spaceship to take on six dangerous settings, ranging from a pleasant garden to hostile fire and tough ice. You will have to fly freely before cutting through tunnels and canyons, and finally destroying an alien base. Your energy read out starts at 1200 and decreases as shots hit you, or you make contact with a wall or blockage. You have infinite cannons and guided missiles to help you along. You can get regular energy recharges and power upgrades, by shooting and then collecting their carrier pods.

At the start of the game, the player may select any one of five planets:

Megaleon (Man-Made world): This is default start level. The first half consists of combat in open space, slowly approaching a fortress inside the planet. Enemies include fighter ships, with the only obstacle being an orbital construction site.
Ashutar (Volcanic world): Here, the player must traverse through two fortresses.
Malkland (Plant world): Obstacles here include a fast growing plant which entangles your ship. Like Ashutar, two fortresses must be traversed.
Sara (Desert world): The player here must avoid tornadoes and surface-to-air fire.
Orthea (Cloud world): This stage contains large formations of enemy fighters. Two fortresses must be traversed.
A sixth and final planet may be accessed only once the other five have been overcome:

Hyperspace (Final): This is the stronghold of the enemy forces.

142733.overview:
Taken into slavery as a child, his parents slaughtered by the Romans,
Spartacus was destined to become on of the most famous heroes of all time.
He was trained to fight in the arena, spending many years perfecting his
skills with the sword, shield and spear. Time could not tame him, Spartacus
never forgot the freedome of his past, or the cruel ways of the Roman
Empire.

When his time came to be called to the arena, Spartacus new this was his
chance for revenge. He was to fight the champions fo the arena, in the
presence of the evil Roman Emperor, Crassus. If he could beat these
experienced gladiators, he might be able to escape. Spartacus knew, from the
other slaves, that his plan was filled with danger, he would have to flee
through the streets of Capau and beyond, killing anyone or anything that
stood in his way.

This is your chance to play the part of Spartacus The Sword Slayer in this
epic tale of death and honour.

143453.overview: Your job is to supervise the maintenance robots of the space station, when it makes a crash landing on an unknown planet... Your aim: to escape from the wreck before it disintegrates completely, keeping out of the way of the robots, who by now have become uncontrollable. 100% arcade action in a side-on 3-dimensional universe.

143619.overview: For a long time you were the most successful double-agent between the pirates and the Federation. Now the Federation has discovered your crimes and you are fugitive. You flee to the pirates, but they throw you out! You have only two opportunities: get imprisoned or fight for your rehabilitation. You steal a little fighter of the R11 class and a laser-gun and fight for the Federation without order! Be careful: the whole universe will be on your heels.

143624.overview:
This is a turn-based strategy game set during the Bolivian civil war in 1966/67. The player takes the role of Ché Guevara, best known for his role during the Cuban revolution, with the goal to conquer the city La Paz.

The game is mostly menu based (with some digitised pictures thrown in) where the player commands the 15 revolutionaries. The available options are resting, moving through Bolivia, consulting maps to get an idea where to go, training to increase the statistics of the troops, defending (helps the odds when government troops attack) or sending out scouts. Most important is the food supply which can be either obtained by buying it (when in a village) or hunting (the success depends on the region). If it gets scarce, the player can ration it - but this has negative effect on the combat performance. Ambushes are either calculated automatically or, if it is lead by Guevara, plays out as a first-person action sequence. Here the player moves a crosshair over the screen and shoots popping out enemies.

143628.overview: You control a ship at the bottom of the screen and blast away at oncoming enemies. The enemies in Galaga first fly in and line up in formation and then dive-bomb at you while firing sometimes in predictable patterns and sometimes not.

143634.overview: You must control a futuristic alien vehicle and skim over the surface of a planet attempting to blast away all enemies whilst trying to free prisoners who are kept captive there.

143667.overview: Gravity Power took the tiny arrow ship from the classic Asteroids, put in another one and made them fight against each other, with the aid of astonishing weaponry and refueling pads, and with the impediment of lethal landscapes, tricky tunnels and automatic wall-mounted ship-seeking cannons.

143910.overview: In the Gardener, the player takes the role of the gnome who need to navigate through series of platforms, pick up his vegetables, avoid nasties and exit the level.

143927.overview: Genocide Earth is what is known as a text adventure. This type of game began life in the early eighties. Genocide Earth contains many puzzles, all of which must be solved to win the game.

143945.overview: Georg Glaxo is a promotional game released by the Danish subsidiary of pharmaceutical company Glaxo. It's a side scrolling platform shooter where the player takes control of Georg, a boy who has asthma. The game consists of four levels, each representing one of the seasons of the year. In each level the young boy will come across various animals that he can dodge or shoot at. Some of these, like sharks, are direct dangers while others just affects Georg's asthma. If it gets too bad he will get sick, start to cough and move slower. However this can be prevented by taking the right medicine. There are three different kinds of medicine, Flixotide (orange), Serevent (green) and Ventoline (blue). The orange and green should be taken every morning and evening, while the blue one is taken when Georg gets sick. A green, yellow and orange meter shows the current condition. If the marker is within the green area everything is okay.

144259.overview:
As rebel forces close in on the space station Gallion, you launch strikes against enemy-controlled planets in the most sophisticated techno-toy available to mankind, the space fighter Thunder Cloud II.

The game is a blend of action sequences in an Afterburner-esque pseudo-3D view. These sequences vary between ground combat, aerial combat and space combat, with different motion physics and enemy craft. There is also a strategic battle choices on a galactic map invaded in real-time.

The PC version uses speaker tweaks to recreate the game's tune on theoretically-inferior hardware.

144267.overview:
Galaxy 89 is a Galaga clone. The player controls a spaceship that can only move left and right at the bottom of the screen. The aim of the game is to destroy as many enemy waves as possible without losing all of the extra lives.

Pressing the fire button fires a shot at the enemy attack waves, which enter the screen from different edges. The only other movement possible for the player is a diagonal shot, by moving the controller in the opposite direction they want to fire. The game gets gradually harder with waves appearing behind the player or large amounts of enemy shots the player has to avoid.

Having its roots in an arcade game, the objective of Galaxy 89 is to gain the highest possible score. Destroying waves of enemies gives the player points, as well as the bonus rounds considering mostly of cannon fodder-type enemies that occur after clearing a certain number of waves.

144268.overview:
The Citizens Defence Force does not trust the United Nations to keep a troubled 21st century world at peace. It confiscates a horde of planes and warships, and as a UN loyalist, it is your job to shoot them down. Solving starvation and disease can wait, apparently.

The game is split into 8 stages, which are split into sub-stages over land and sea, each of which has a strict time limit, and a target number of planes to shoot down. They take place from behind your plane, which can be controlled with ‘up’ referring to ‘climb’ or ‘dive’, depending on player preference. You are armed with 10 missiles as well as standard weapons. The plane can survive a few hits, so watch the damage report as it goes from red to black.

Fail to complete a section in the time limit and you use up a continue, but the amount of planes previously shot down is not reset, making the second attempt easier Chase HQ style. As you destroy enemies you gain access to better planes, and the rank reported at the end of the game improves – this is also dependent on the skill level you play at.

144269.overview:
Gettysburg is a wargame simulating the Battle of Gettysburg (fought on July 1-3, 1863), the turning point and one of the bloodiest battles of the American Civil War. You may choose to command either Union or Confederate forces, it is also possible to play a two player game or watch the computer playing both sides.

As in the previous games in this series, the player is observing the battle area through a 3D perspective, while issuing commands by typing in certain pre-defined text elements (combined with names of commanders, places and time of execution). You will get reports from your officers indicating whether or not your orders have been carried out to the letter.

144270.overview:
Ghost Chaser is an Amiga maze game released in 1990 by Byte Back. The game was designed by Nick Orridge, Nik Sen and Paul Johnson of Cloud Nine Developments.

Description (from back of box):

A cold mist swirls around you. The dark eerie maze closes in on all sides.

You're a hunter, a ghost chaser. Your weapons are flashing dots of fruit. Eat them to gain power... but quickly -

Any minute you could feel a damp breath on your neck and turn the corner on an avenue of terror.

144271.overview:
In The Magic Garden (re-released as Gnome Alone), the player takes the role of the gnome Grobble whose attempt at a robbery failed. His sentence: garden work. Only after reaching a certain amount of effectiveness, the next level can be tackled.

In its core, this is a time management game. There are various tasks to take care of like watering plants, mowing the lawn, repairing broken parts of the garden or catching another gnome which messes up the garden. Some of those tasks appear randomly and other are a direct result of the weather and temperature. However, all require the use of tools which can be fetched at certain buildings, but taking too many of them causes Grobble to be overworked. His exhaustion is shown with another bar, basically a time limit, which can be lowered by eating certain plants or finding special items at more far off parts of the garden like the tunnel system. The garden, which is the main part of the game, is shown from a top-down perspective.

144272.overview:
Go Player is a computer adaption of the old board game Go which is most often played in Eastern Asia. The basic principle is that two players (one white, the other black) place stones on a 19x19 board. The goal is to control as big as possible areas on the board by circling it with own stones. Likewise, enemy stones can be taken out of the game by circling them. At the end of the match (when both players pass their turn) the size of controlled areas and the taken out stones determine the winner.

This game features two smaller boards (9x9 and 13x13) and handicap options, both adapted from real-life rule adaptions. There are also 101 difficulty levels and the option to pre-define the board to practice special match situations.

144274.overview:
Goldrunner II is set 50 years after the events of its predecessor. Since then humanity has started to use robot pilots for defense, but space pirates have managed to capture them. The hero, the grandchild of the original Goldrunner, now has to save or at least destroy the robots before they can be used against their creators.

To do so he flies through 16 vertically scrolling levels, called platforms, to shoot down the transporters carrying the robots. Then he collects the robots (the capacity is up to five at a time) flies to the teleporter station, unloads and repeats until all robots in the level are captured or destroyed. Well, it is not that easy: every destroyed transporter causes recovery ships - basically enemy fighters and mines - to show up, which need to be destroyed first. The game also features dust clouds which block the ship's shots and smart bombs which destroy all enemies on the screen when used.

144275.overview: This data disk for "Graham Gooch World Class Cricket" includes 1993 squads for 18 English counties and an updated England squad, but does not include five historic cricket matches as stated in the manual.

144276.overview: This version of the game combines the original game with the 2nd Innings update.

144277.overview:
Graeme Souness Soccer Manager is a basic football managing game based on the English leagues where the player is responsible for bringing a team (any available) from the Conference to the top division.

Options are limited: the player can select the starting eleven, the players being rated in both ability and fitness, explore the transfer market for signing better players and request overdraft extensions. While no player refuses the sign for your team (even if it's still on the Conference), the real game challenge is to balance finances, and avoid paying too much in wages while still in the lower divisions.

144278.overview:
The most important feature of Graeme Souness: Vector Soccer are the three-dimensional vector graphics. To accompany this, the camera perspectives are relatively near to the playfield; a small overlay of the whole field which is shown in the right corner is required to get an overview.

The rest of the game offers no surprises: the player takes the role of a soccer team, either during a friendly match or a tournament, and tries to win. The athletes are directly controlled and are able to perform actions like shooting or passing. There are various match settings available, e.g. difficulty level or match length. In multiplayer mode, either two players play against each other or up to eight players are responsible for one team each during a tournament.

144279.overview:
In Goofy's Railway Express, Goofy and Mickey are railroad conductors helping children with colors and shapes. This is done by a series of screens for young children to start visually identifying shapes and color matching while the train crosses colorful landscapes.

When the train smoke stack produces colored shapes, such as a square, circle, or triangle, the child must press the spacebar key. If the shape and color matches the shape and color above a Disney character waiting on the train platform, then the train will stop and pick up that passenger. Otherwise an unique animation appears somewhere on the screen for entertainment.

144281.overview:
Grand Slam: World Class Tennis is a tennis simulation in which the player has the opportunity to participate in the four grand slam tournaments which consist of three matches each.

While the mouse-controls itself offer no surprises, the player needs to click at the right time to start a hit and depending on the ball and athlete position either a forehand or backhand is played. There are a variety of factors which influence the match: The court surface and weather influences the ball movement and the chosen racket influence the hitting. Additionally there is the option to complain against a referee decision and a practice mode in which the match settings can be changed.

144282.overview: Grid Start is a Formula 1 racing game played from a third person perspective similar to Pole Position. The game consists of six tracks based on real world locations: Brands Hatch, Silverstone, Belgium, Mexico, Austria and Germany. These can be played in a competition consisting of three laps or in a practice mode with 99 laps (or until the player presses the escape key). In each race there are 23 AI controlled cars to compete against. The game is playable in three difficulties: novice, amateur and professional. The car has six gears that have to be changed manually and a boost feature can also be used for faster acceleration. In addition to racing faster than the opposing drivers the player also has to avoid crashing into the haystacks and the fences that are placed dangerously close to the track.

144283.overview: Set in the future, Globetrotter is a side view scrolling game where the screen scrolls to the left or right when the basketball you have to bounce moves over various levels. You control a bat and you have to use it to bounce the basketball from the left of a level to the right and put in it a basket before a timer runs out. You can move the bat anywhere on the screen but the ball will bounce off objects and will burst if it hits certain objects and if it bursts then you lose 10 seconds off the timer. You can change the angle of the bat by holding the fire button down and turning it 360 degrees left or right. Once you get the ball in the basket then you move to the next level and receive a bonus for any time left. Two players can play, with each player playing at the same time and if a player moves off the screen then they lose 10 seconds off their timer and one player has to put the ball in the basket for both to progress. At the start of the game you can select one of the first five levels.

144284.overview:
Great Napoleonic Battles is a turn-based hex wargame which not only allows players to play three epic battles from the Napoleonic Wars but also includes a construction kit to re-create any land-based battle of the Napoleonic period.

It consists of four programs: a 'Battle' program to play scenarios; a 'Mapmaker' to customise or create new maps; a 'Menmaker to create or modify units and pieces used in the battles; and a 'Warmaker' to modify rules, objectives and conditions of combat.

The game comes with three ready-made scenarios - the battles of Marengo and Waterloo, where you play the French, and the battle of Quatre Bras where you play the British. Players can choose to play either side in a user-created scenario, or create two-player scenarios.

144288.overview:
It's fourth and goal on the two with ten seconds left in the game. The crowd is roaring as you approach the line and scan the defense. It's no good... something's not right. You decide to call an audible... that speacial play you've been saving for a moment like this. The center snaps the ball. You hand off to the halfback who sweeps right spins and fires a bullet back to you in the end zone. The scoreboard lights up as the crowd goes wild... TOUCHDOWN!!

Welcome to GRIDIRON!, the most realistic football game ever created for a personal computer. Designed for one or two players, GRIDIRON! offers you five levels of play from Practice all the way to Pro.

There has never been a football game more playable than GRIDIRON! You have the kind of control you'd expect only on a real football field. You can set up a play, look at the defense, change your mind and then call an audible. When the action starts, things happen fast! On offense you control the ball carrier, on defense you control any player you choose. The other players execute the play you selected.

GRIDIRON! is comprehensive and flexible as well. Using the Player Draft you can set the speed and strength for each player on both offense and defense. You can use any of 40 plays in the standard Playbook, or modify them to create your own unique plays using the powerful Play Creation Utility, our electronic chalkboard. You can even save your plays and teams on disk for future games!

Our digitized audio will transport you into the stadium with the crowd roaring, the referee blowing his whistle, the linemen hitting on the line of scrimmage and the Quaterback calling the count.

GRIDIRON! is more than a game. It is a simulation where the only limits are your skill and imagination.

Bethesda Softworks is credited with the creation of the first physics-based sports simulation, Gridiron!, in 1986 for the Atari ST, Commodore Amiga and Commodore 64/128. Early games scored respectably in the gaming press. Electronic Arts was working on the first John Madden Football at the time, and hired Bethesda to help finish developing it. At the same time, they acquired distribution rights for future versions of Gridiron!

144289.overview:
Grimblood is a murder mystery game that takes place in a medieval castle that is populated by ritual performing psychotic people. The only sane person in the castle is the player character, Earl Maximus, and only he can unmask the murderer that stalks the halls of the castle.

When starting out the player is shown an overview of the castle and by clicking on its windows it's possible to travel to a specific room. After travelling to a location the exploration screen opens which shows a first person view of the location. From here it's possible to explore the castle freely while observing its inhabitants. While exploring, the game runs in real time and new murders are likely to occur during this time if the perpetrator isn't caught. Talking to people is done through the interrogation screen and when it is open the game time pauses. It shows portraits of all the people in the current room and clicking on any of them starts a conversation. The conversation is controlled with the function keys and these can be used to ask questions, make accusations and give orders.

To win the game the player has to accuse the right person of being the murderer and this has to be done with at least one witness nearby. The murderer will then confess but if there is no witness he will kill the player too and escape. However if the player accuses too many innocents the people will be fed up and might throw him out of the castle.

144290.overview:
In the future NYC has become inhospitable and depraved, with thugs lining every street waiting to pounce on ordinary civilians. Thankfully Freddy Hardest is on hand to face up to the baseball bats and knives, in a side-scrolling beat 'em up game.

As with any Dinamic title, the difficulty level is set high. A few kicks and punches are available to you, and you have one life with energy which depletes as you get hit, but can be recharged by finding a safe space to stand still.

145983.overview:
An indelible memory for the entire '80s cohort of UK schoolchildren, this educational game, originally released in 1983 on the BBC Micro, solicits textual input from the player regarding the correct approach and technique for rescuing three pairs of royal children from a wicked witch. A variety of puzzle types with a wide and whimsical supporting cast kept classes of kids debating the correct course of action through an array of different environments, progress through each tracked courtesy of a password system.

Some 15 or so years later, the game's developers eventually released a multimedia-enhanced remake of it for modern operating systems.

150876.overview: George and the Repton-clone is a clone of an old BBC game (later released on the ZX Spectrum) Repton 2. You start on the main level, which contains a number of teleporters leading to the other levels. The object of the game is to collect all of the diamonds on each level, and then reach the exit, which will take you back to the main level, which you should clear of teleporters. This makes the game slightly less linear, and allows you to practice harder levels - you don't have to do the levels in order, but you may block the entrance to some levels if you don't.

150981.overview: Get Out is a top-down Breakout clone with highly polished graphics. The gameplay is orthodox, with the only addition being the ten power-ups dropped from destroyed bricks, and the usual kinds of "soft" and "hard" bricks, the latter requiring several hits to be destroyed. Certain blocks are even indestructible. The power-ups are: Fast ball, slow ball, bonus points, extra life, smaller bat, bigger bat, double balls, smart bomb and reverse controls.

150997.overview: The Getaway is the long awaited sequel to Kelly's Rescue, which was first released on the C64. The game starts where the Kelly’s Rescue ends, you escaping the manhunt by slipping into the deserted building from which the front door was slightly ajar. To find out what happens next, start new episode of Kelly’s Rescue.

151005.overview: One of the earliest games by Dynamix programmers, GBA Championship Football is a solid text-based simulation of the gridiron sport. The goal is simple: pick a team from NFL's four geographic divisions and lead it to win over the opposing side, whether human or computer-controlled. The game's playbook is quite comprehensive for its age, and the strategy does affect the outcome of the game. Too bad there is no tournament or championship mode despite the game's title, making it good only as a quick beer-and-pretzel football fix instead of a comprehensive simulation. In all, a respectable effort for the time, although falls short of rivaling XOR's NFL Challenge, a much deeper and more sophisticated contemporary football simulation.

151008.overview: Giełda Światowa is a turn based economic game for up to 5 players. The game allows to choose one of three goals - earn 100.000 $, survive on the market for three years, bring to bankrupt your opponents. Gameplay is all about goods stock exchange trading and making financial operations. Stock exchange trading includes 12 goods in 10 countries. Trading is done on the basis of buy cheap and sell expensive, plus pay as little as possible for shipping costs. Goods transport allows to choose between car, train, ship and airplane with insurance possibility. Each turn ends up with a summary, which includes tax expenses and a transport arrival summary. The game features advanced set of comparative statistics.

151786.overview:
A dying man is found on your doorstep. He hands you a map and in his dying breath, tells of a great treasure of gold located in one of four castles built by the Four Princes of the Realm. Although deserted for many years now, the gold still remains, along with only a few evil things and remnants of sorcery that watch over the treasure. With only your work horse as company you leave on your quest. At the start of this game of exploration, you have a choice of difficulty, Easy, Medium, and Hard.

Make your way through the castles by picking up items and using them when necessary. Avoid being touched by a spook - they will steal your current item and drop it somewhere in the Realm. Map and save often to succeed on your quest. If you have defeated all obstacles, and have the treasure, go back to your horse, and press the joystick button.

151789.overview:
Probably the first retro-collection ever foisted upon the buying public, [Golden Oldies is a] collection of 4 classic computer games (well, 3 computer games and an adaptation of an electronic video game). Play Eliza, Conway's Life, Crowther's Adventure, or Al Alcorn's Pong. All 4 games are liberal adaptations- there is no standard Eliza, and this versions seems to lack compared to others. Pong is an ASCII rendition of the game (and includes a remake with color!) Life, however, includes various pre-formed populations, including the infamous glider-gun that figures prominently in the book "Hackers"

The games are not as fun as their originals, but they are good enough to give you a good sense of nostalgia... and a peek of how gaming looked in 1984. Recommended if you collect oldies, but probably won't be of interest to a casual gamer.

151798.overview: In Gone Fish'n you play the owner of a small business who is trying to juggle work with his hobby of fishing. At the start of each week, you examine the weather forecast and decide when to work and when to fish. Fish too often and you'll have no money left for your hobby. Unless... you enter and win a Bass tournament.

151810.overview:
Gonks is a puzzle game starring the Gonks, another stupid species which is only capable of walking forward and turning around when meeting an obstacle. The goal of each level (overall 40) is to lead them to their houses. In later levels there are Gonks of different colours which need to go to the house of the same colour.

Each level is divided in two phases. The first one is on a timer and is the main playing phase. Here the player uses blocks and ladders to create a way for the Gonks. Rockets and bombs can be used to destroy obstacles. If the time runs out (or the player has finished the work), the Gonks start to walk and the only thing left to do is hoping that the preparations were correct. A level can be restarted anytime.

152213.overview: Try to avoid the spotlight until the time runs out. If you come into contact with the spotlight, you die. Nice idea, but you only get one life.

152217.overview: A multi-screen, multi-directional platformer published in Amiga Computing no. 28, Sep 1990 by the same team that worked the  development of the games 'Night Walk' (1988) and the famous 'Lure of the Temptress' (1992).

153188.overview:
GunBee F-99 was an unlicensed port of Detana!! TwinBee for the Amiga, published by APC&TCP and developed by Twin Eagles Group.

There are two modes: Honey Mode, which served as a training mode, and Story Mode, which directed to the intro of the story. While the gameplay was based on TwinBee, the intro was similar to the one seen in Turrican 3: Payment Day. Kiara McGuire was a reference to Ben McGuire from the Turrican series.

158412.overview: A fabulous game written exclusively for this Christmas. From Santa and the software elves. Welcome to the world of magical castles weird creatures and hidden treasures. Welcome to the world of Rudolfph, the Santa. Welcome to Galactic X-Mas.

160554.overview:
Game coded in AmigaBASIC. Included a bonus game, EVIL DAWN, and seemingly was never released as a pure standalone game.
Original release contents also contained 5 plastic counters and a world map for use with GLOBAL TREK.

178120.overview:
In this traditional baseball simulation, gameplay takes place mainly on a split screen.One side shows an overview of the field, the other showing the batter, with the latter view disappearing when the ball is hit.

The game requires you to "draft" a team before play, composing the best possible squad based on each player's skill attributes. The game also allows a semblance of managerial control, and has an optional batting practice mode to warm up. It then allows you to play individual games, or participate in a 4 division, 24-team championship.

178133.overview: Genetic Species is a first-person 3D shooter set in the grim 22nd century. Ruthless corporations dominate the world and only the CFA (Counter Force Alliance) dare oppose them. Upon entering the game, several corporate bases have been attacked by an unknown force and it's your mission to investigate these attacks. To do this, you play as a BioShifter, which is a unit capable of taking control of living creatures as well as cyborgs and droids via their electronic implants. The gameplay in Genetic Species is familiar and like most shooters, the emphasis is on action. Still, the game contains many original items and weapons, some of which are quite unique and allows you to tune down the killing.

178216.overview:
Pursuit to Earth is a shoot-'em-up game in the tradition of single-screen shooters in which the player controls a space craft defending himself against waves of approaching enemy formations. Like in the arcade game Gyruss, the player moves along a circle around the centre of the screen, and moving left and right on the circular path. The playfield is three-dimensional, with the player's ship firing to the distance. Enemies are approaching from behind the player or from the depth of the screen, but contact with alien ships does not do any harm. The aliens are also firing bullets, which are instantly deadly to the player, bringing the ship back to the Hyperspace portal.

During the fight red pills are flying from the depth of the playfield, which should be collected to be traded for extra weapons. Those contain speed buffs, missiles, shields and satellites.

181255.overview: Genius is a puzzle game which has a similar principle as the board game Mastermind. The player gets presented with a cube network and needs to find out the colours of the cube surfaces. After making a choice, the game says how well the attempt fared and the player needs to logically work the correct combination out by making more and more attempts. There are various options to set the game, e.g. the number of cubes, an optional time limit, the difficulty level or a limitation of attempts. An option for advanced players are cubes which change their positions between attempts.

181256.overview: European version(s) of the popular US TV game show Wheel of Fortune. A very basic translation of the popular game show Wheel Of Fortune, where you guess letters until you can guess the phrase. This CGA version has three old-school rounds of Wheel of Fortune (where the puzzles are simply "Phrase", "Title", "Person", etc.) and then a bonus round. You can compete against 2 computer players or up to three people can play against each other.

181257.overview:
Growth is an arcade game loosely extending the Arkanoid principle, shifting the focus from the classic ball and bat schema more on the shooting bat extra weapon of Arkanoid and only adding he ball as bonus.

The player controls the bat and can not only move it at the bottom of the screen, but also around the screen borders, so you can move it to the left, right and top of the screen as well. The bat have shooting abilities by default, which is badly required, as the eye in the center of the screen is constantly popping up new stones to the playfield. A life is lost if the growing stone formation is reaching any border. The goal in most levels is to simply destroy the eye in the center of the screen, which can be achieved by shooting through the stones until the eye itself can be hit while controlling the expansion of the stones.

There are some levels in which a ball is present, which also can be used to destroy the stones and is played like in any Breakout-like game. Some extra levels are plain shoot-'em-up style: moving enemy formations are approaching and the player has to shoot them to proceed further.

181580.overview:
Ultimate Gloom aka Gloom 3: Zombie Edition is a first-person shooter game, developed by Alpha and published by Guildhall Leisure Services Ltd., which was released in 1997. Using the Gloom Deluxe engine, Gareth Murfin of Alpha Software released the third in the Gloom series. The use of the same engine as the last game is both a strength and a weakness; the engine is good but its single plane levels restricts the variety that can
be achieved. This time the character of Gloom and Gloom Deluxe is up against an outbreak of zombies. Everyone loves zombies (well,
nearly) and loves taking them out.

197330.overview: Gobblers is a puzzle game written in AMOS where your goal is to get the gobbler to get the bone. Gobbler walks randomly around the screen. When you move, the tiles get removed behind you. By narrowing down the moving space for the gobbler the game becomes increasingly more difficult because if the Gobbler touches you, it's game over. When he gets the bone, it's on to the next level. Late levels add objects like humans to the field that you need to protect from the Gobbler. The game was published as Shareware by Mollysoft Europe in 1992.

201393.overview:
Chessmate V1.2 is a chess game written in AmigaBASIC by John Krause. The ultimate in computer chess. Spectacular graphics. 2D or 3D. You vs Amiga. You vs Friend. Amiga vs Amiga. Multiple skill levels. Game clocks. Book moves. Displays move list. Suggests moves. Save game. Speaks moves. Master games and problems included. Plus much more.

It was also released in Germany as "Grossmeister", published by HS&Y in 1988.

201433.overview: Great States II is an educational game teaching geography. The main game is a map based quiz that exist in eight varieties with different subjects: states, capitals, birds, flowers, trees, date entered union, state abbreviation and state nickname. They all work in the same way with the player being presented with a map and has to either click on the correct country or type in its name for each question given. A game runs until a set number of questions have been asked. Additionally there is a tutorial where the player can explore the states and get info and maps which show various statistics such as vegetation and population.

201652.overview:
Mutants have been found in the bombed out Polish city codenamed 'Gorky 17' near Lubin, and a trio of soldiers (Sullivan, Owicz and Trantigne, each of different nationalities) enter the city to find out what happened and find any member of the first squad previously sent there. You control the team and direct them through the world of surprises and mysteries that wait to be resolved.

The game features two modes: In the real-time 'exploration' mode, the player controls game characters using a mouse in a point-and-click manner to navigate the player characters through the city as well as interacting with various objects in the game world. Combat takes place in preset encounters located in specific areas of each level map. In the combat mode, the screen is divided into squares with player and computer-controlled characters taking turns trying to eliminate the opposing party. In one turn each game character can move by a certain number of squares and use a weapon once, or decide to take cover instead. Weapons have different tactical effects, for example the pistol can only be fired orthogonally, while the rifle can be fired orthogonally and diagonally. The game ends if any player-controlled character dies.

205898.overview:
Giana's Return is a fan-made sequel to the videogame The Great Giana Sisters. A German-Austrian-French team, the founders of the independent studio Retroguru in 2011, developed the game from 1998 to 2014.

One night, while dreaming, Giana returns to the land she had first visited in the original Giana Sisters. She discovers that her sister, Maria, has been captured and brought to this land, and so Giana sets out to free Maria from the monster—known as Swampy-that captured her.

208650.overview: Green Beret​ ​is a run and gun game developed and released by Konami in arcades in 1985. It was ported to home systems, becoming a critical and commercial success for arcades and home computers. It was released as Green Beret internationally, and as Rush'n Attack in North America as a play on "Russian attack"​ ​ due to its Cold War setting. It is remembered for​ this Cold War setting and its reliance on the player using mainly a knife to dispatch enemies, although you were able to collect many different weapons including the flame thrower. ​Developer Dante Mendes has finally released the Arcade conversion of Green Beret which has been developed for the Amiga using Earok's Scorpion Engine.

209038.overview: Giana Sisters Special Edition is an unofficial hack of the original Amiga version that replaces the entire visual aspect of the game! The new gfx are either completely new designs or remastered originals, while Giana and some enemies are directly inspired from the 2009 DS version. Featuring over 200 new tiles and frames of animation, new palettes for each level, cosmetic level edits, a revised scrolling title screen, new logo, splash screen and icon, replacements for many of the original sound effects and a new intro ported from the DS version!

209308.overview:
Originally featured on the cover disc of Amiga Format -magazine, when you see a game called "Girl Actions", you wouldn't probably  think "Galaxian clone". That, however, is exactly what this game is. The name is a play on words as it sounds like Galaxians.

Later released by far more sensible name "Alien Fight", your job is to shoot the aliens before they reach the ground.

211149.overview: Our adventure begins with our quest seeker George Angus,a young talented research analyst for a low-tech firm. While searching through his desk he stumbles across a page torn from a translation book of ancient script. Fascinated by his finding and bored with his job, Geo starts off across a world adventure of daring and danger in search of this lost ancient civilization.

211150.overview: Sequel to Geo's Quest and precursor to Geo's Quest 3: Gateway to Nowhere.We join our adventurer Geo as he sleeps. Being a techy in a low tech firm, Geo's mind often wonders to forgotten lost lands. He often dreams of the same land & people every night only to awake before he discovers who and where they are. Will this finally be the night Geo's dreams are answered?

211151.overview:
Let's rejoin our adventurer George Angus as he attempts to traverse the whirlwind era of 90's computing. 

We left off in Chapter 3 as George finds and rescues his beloved Queen Lorraine from the grasps of The Gates of Bill. But alas, the Knights of Escom whom the Queen was entrusted to have failed and she is lost once more.

So George is summoned once more by the diabolical professor Ali to save the Queen again.

George is joined by Commodore legend Dave Haynie in the Quest to save the Queen.  

Having the blessing  of Hazy Dave himself, chapter five "Haynie's Comet" follows (loosely) his path immediately following the demise of Commodore (Pios, MetaBox, Merlancia, Fortele) . There is also another current Amiga celebrity who has also approved the use of his likeness, but no spoiler alert, you'll have to play to find out who. ;-)

As with GQ2 "In Search of Queen Lorraine" these next two chapters where started in 2000 only to be shelved shortly thereafter as life intervened, to be returned to upon my retirement in 2021. So there are literally years and thousands of hours invested in the story, coding, graphics and music. The unfinished buggy version of GQ3 (chapter 4 only) was uploaded to Aminet way back in 2002 and had floated around since. Now it is reworked, repaired and completed offering over 100 hand drawn rooms and closeups, dozens of puzzles and tasks to complete, and dozens of samples and mods to enhance the game play. It was developed using Edmond Clay's great GRAC2 adventure game engine. Some of the graphics, mods & samples are from the AMOS PD Library, but had to be reworked, redrawn, rerecorded to work/fit in the GRAC2 environment and game genre. Original authors unknown.

The genre continues in the various Roberta Williams Sierra  Quests of the 80's and 90's. It is in 32 color 320 x 200 resolution available in both PAL and NTSC video versions.

The game is intended for teens and up with some light adult language, humor and situations. You cannot die in the game when making a wrong decision; there is no violence or  blood; rather it is intended to be an interactive story similar to enjoying a movie night out. It will challenge your problem solving and critical thinking skills to complete and should be completed in one or two sittings.

A guide is included with the game and it is strongly recommended you read it first prior to playing to ensure a better gaming experience.

Requirements: Any Amiga/Emulated Amiga with 2mb chip ram and 2.04 Rom(s) with 18mb free hard drive space.  

****Have at least 1.5mb Chip Ram Free to play the game*****

Recommended: Any Amiga with 2mb chip ram 2.04Rom(s) '020/greater CPU with 18mb free hard drive space.

Now off to complete Chapter six "There Be Cows"

Thanks for playing Geo's Quest.

211152.overview:
Gordian Tomb is a flip-screen platform game from Germany. Montezuma's Revenge seems to be a major influence on the overall design. The main protagonist is a relic hunter that must explore a pyramid to find a secret treasure room. He must pick up and use various tools on his way to overcome obstacles and access unreachable areas. Objects are collected by colliding with them. In order to be able to collect an object, the player must first find the screen where it has to be used. Otherwise, the object can't be taken and the game gives a warning in the hint area: "Later dude!".

The protagonist has to avoid death by wild animals, dangerous environments and supernatural phenomena. On the top of the screen there is the ever-decreasing timer. Below that is displayed a hint (if available) about the screen, usually describing what object can be used. At the bottom there are several slots for the paraphernalia collected, and below that images of the protagonist as the number of lives. The game starts with a 32 minutes time limit and 8 lives, and has no form of saving progress.

Published in CP Verlag's Golden Disk 64 #09 (1990).

211382.overview: Scheduled for release in 1987, GAUNTLET was never published on the Amiga at the time despite popular misconceptions that it was and advertisements appearing in many computer magazines of the time. The Amiga version was created by Philippe Guichardon in 2012 by reverse engineering the Atari ST version.

211422.overview:
An Asteroids clone without friction, but with power ups and great music. The solar system is in danger. The aliens of The Xenon system have returned with their army of attack starships and have caused distortions in the asteroid belt.

This caused a chain reaction of meteors swarming throughout the solar system, a danger for moons and planets. You, our fearless hero Jason Crusher and your Golden Wing ship must defend the entire solar system from this invasion, you are the only one left, our last hope.
Thanks to Frank Wille (phx) for the music/sfx replayer!

211522.overview:
Here we are with our second production. It's rather short, mostly multiplayer party game called GermZ. 

Game explains true origins of pandemic.. and its final consequences. Become tiny organism, infect and spread to fulfill your Creator bidding or face others in fierce multiplayer battles to be the last GermZ standing.

211562.overview:
The annual Mushroom Festival is considered the event of the year. People from all around attend to celebrate and remember the events of the past. Long ago, an evil wizard was defeated using only a mushroom. Ever since then, that very mushroom has held a place of honor in the center of the town of Phungoria, and a new person is appointed each year to watch over it. Suddenly one morning the mushroom is stolen, and Gilbert Goodmate's grandfather, this year's keeper of the mushroom, has been blamed. Somehow Gilbert must find the mushroom, the thief, and save his grandfather from the gallows!

Gilbert Goodmate and the Mushroom of Phungoria is a humorous, 3rd person point and click adventure game made in similar style to the Lucas Monkey Island series. Gilbert's quest will involve exploring in and outside of Phungoria, talking to a multitude of characters and solving inventory-based puzzles. The game features hand-drawn, cartoon style graphics, an original musical score, and a cast of voice actors and actresses.

211657.overview: The Golden Medallion is an adventure game. The story begins when sorcerer Yenkin's feelings for the princess Perl have been rejected by her father. As a revenge, he decided to kidnap the object of his love. Taking the role of Dobromir the player must reach the land of Owlmountains and find the Golden Medallion. The game is divided into several locations with different puzzles. A task's solution open the access to the next area. The game features land, underwater and air stages.

211804.overview:
Gate 2 Freedom is a fantasy platform game with some adventure elements. The player may walk, jump, take, drop or use item. Pocket fits one item at a time. Contact with spikes or hostile creatures takes some energy. The energy may be supplemented by eating an apple. The main tasks are given by sorcerer hidden inside the magic gate, filling them requires perform numerous mini-quests and proving dexterity skill.
The game is Polish but most of the text in game is in English.

211897.overview: 17 levels of progressively more difficult play. Each level of this shooter has a different secret bonus. These are awarded to players who correctly execute the level's secret subtask. There are also 4 universal secret bonuses that can be earned on each level.  Carefully navigate the mazes and corridors to save the humans, blast the turrets, keep up your fuel level and have fun with a gun!

211941.overview: You gather new abilities along the way which opens up new areas. You have unlimited lives and the game can be rather brutal at some places, but just keep on trying and you will prevail :) The "torches" are checkpoints and you will spawn by the latest one you touched if you die. Controls are simple, left and right to move and fire to jump, press down to drop through some floors.

211942.overview: The game is a solid platformer with a main character that doesn't have any attacks. It controls well enough and has decent graphics for a budget release. There is no ingame music, only sound effects and the occasional speech sample to cheer you on. One problem I had with the game was that it is sometimes not clear if an object is in the background or will block your path.

211943.overview:
A very good and fast gravity/thrust game that runs smoothly and needs more levels. Gravity Beam tips its second hand hat at classics such as Thrust or Lunar Lander, and as the old adage goes, 'Good artists borrow and great artists steal'. There are more stolen bits in this game than your local Cash Converters store but unlike the aforementioned pawn-shop, Gravity Beam won't empty your wallet to enjoy its wares. 
 
There are tons of clones out there, but very few are willing to try something new with the concept. Gravity Beam's gimmick is its namesake, you have a gravity beam which allows you to tow objects to their destinations.

211978.overview: A vertically scrolling shooter created by Marcus Johansson in 1997.

212005.overview: A tough multi screen 2D platformer created in AMOS by Andy Platts. It is a precursor to Glassback 2: The Dole Years.

212007.overview: The flip screen platformer by Andy Platts s a sequel to Glassback.

212178.overview:
Glizdor is an Action game, developed and published by Fundacja Edukacji Technologicznej, which was released in Europe in 1993. Glizdor is an action puzzle game for up to three players. The game allows to use a joystick and definable keys with four movement directions and one action key. The chosen character moves continuously in the manner known from Light Cycle games or Snake games. Each level of the game is preceded by guidelines. Performing all the required actions allows reaching the exit. Contact with any object (excluding exit gate) on the board means the loss of life.

The game features level editor.

212179.overview: The evil Star Thief has raided the night sky of Babbleville and taken the poor stars and left them deep in a cavern. Glodrick has been elected as the one who should be sent into the dark and menacing cave to retrieve the stars. Guide Glodrick through the dangerous screens and collect the stars...

212180.overview: Make your way through enemy controlled territory, the only way is forward but you'll need to take out a lot of them. They know you're coming.

212181.overview: The chopper will drop you off far behind enemy lines with all the ammo and grenades you could ever want. Do what you were trained for and kill 'em all!

212182.overview: A vertically scrolling shooter with multi-directional shooting in this space shooter by  Yasuaki Gohko in 1997.

212330.overview: Our scanners have located an enormous planetoid which seems to have jumped into our system, heading for our main planet NEW PORT. We want you to fly to the planetoid and gather more information, but be careful. Long range scans show small objects that fly like our guardian drones. It is possible that we may be under attack! Good luck.

212331.overview: Kevin Gallagher released a lot of arcade conversions on the Amiga. Earlier versions of Galaxians were featured on a few magazines, this version was the last update to this one and was given away on Amiga Format Issue 127.

212332.overview: A vertically scrolling shooter with programmed waves of enemies that attack to the backdrop of a hostile alien environment. It was created by Syntex in 1995.

212333.overview: You must destroy aliens with your missiles whilst avoiding asteroids and enemy fire. Released on 17 Bit disk no. 3189.

212334.overview: A gem themed style puzzle game for head to head play by Tony Hosier. Clear your gems before your opponent can.

212335.overview: A game that was part of the Assassins 4 compilation, and the Amiga Format Reader Games created by Steve Bailey. In it you play air hockey against your opponent, but with a twist. A worm will pop up during the game that will deflect any shots from either side that hit it, causing some unexpected changes to gameplay.

212355.overview:
A puzzle game game in the style of Pipe Dream, created by Gareth Watt and released in 1993. It is your first day as a plumber. Unfortunately, you have have been assigned to do a job at a haunted house. The problem is that a mysterious liquid called ecto-slime keeps flowing through certain sections of pipeline which you have laid and you are getting pretty irate.  
 
Lay a specific length of pipe. The distance of pipe required is displayed at the bottom right of the play area beside your score. You have a limited amount of time at the beginning before the ecto-slime normally starts to ooze down the pipeline. It will keep flowing until the end of the pipe is reached. Keep laying the correct configuration of pipes in order for the slime not to reach the end of the pipe until you have reached your assigned end piece. Any sections already on the playing field must be used.

212451.overview: A two player game where the sole aim of the game is to blow the other player out of the water. This is done through skillful use of your galleon. The winner is the boat that is still afloat in the water. You can completely destroy the randomly generated land with your cannot barrages. Like asteroids, shots fired on one side of the screen carry over from the other side.

212453.overview:
A small group of scientists searching for fossils found something not seen before on an excavation site. Rather than being fossilized, the small discovery was clearly preserved in a state similar to being frozen. Dr. Maswood, the head of the team, took it back to his lab searching for a way to penetrate the strange rock. Upon cracking the outer layer, he soon learned that the creature, although not alive was not of the life that is currently known during the time of the dinosaurs. Using carbon-dating he traced the blob back to the ice age, and discovered that similar life forms may have existing even until Egyptian rule, with rumored appearances in the iron age and even more recent times. The creature was soft, ball shaped and only responded to certain devices found with it. Other alien artifacts indicated the creature had been given a name that could only be described as unusual. Roughly translated, it was called The Gimp.  
 
The creature, along with the artifacts, it was discovered, could be used for time travel. An expedition was put together to go back and retrieve species that has long since ceased to exist. During that time a second Gimp was found based on information gleaned from the original dig site. Dr. Maswood, upon hearing of your choice to lead the expedition, took the 2nd Gimp and forged ahead, leaving traps for you and The Gimp species behind him. You must work to save both the endangered species and The Gimp. 

You have been given a device that will display the time and even let you freeze it for a very short time. It allows you to direct the Gimp's movement through the trap checkpoints, check inventory (and score and level for you gamers). You can even hit a button to escape the current area at any time.

212454.overview: A stormy night in the near future. The cruise ship Y.T.S. has given out reports of strange craft overhead... Just hours later, all people on board disappear. A U.F.O. was later sighted. You are sent in on a solo mission to find out what the hell happened. You must locate the hidden Red Box which contains monitoring and surveillance information. Once found, HQ will send in a dingy for you. You may then destroy the ship. Beware of the onboard security.

212718.overview: Build ships to the stars, explore and be an ambassador to different planets while building your own. Upgrade armaments for self protection and trade until you are rich and can afford the fastest ships and best armaments.

213366.overview:
You play a group of Russian soldiers who are returning from a traumatic war. The casualties have been massive and you end up trying to take over the entire Kreml. The only obstacle is the Evil League of Puticcian Oligarchs who are lurking inside the fancy looking buildings. You must search and destroy them.

There are 4 different types of units at your disposal: Military Drones, MIG-29, Artillery and a Footman Assassins equipped with a pistol and a set of Novichok. The enemy is trying to mirror the location of your hideout, which must be kept secret.

Game has two levels. The first encounter is at St. Petersburg and the second at Moscow.

213821.overview: The English Football Simulation also known as The German Football Simulation and known as Division 1: Football League Simulator is a Soccer\Football management game. Division One, now's your chance to manage a First Division soccer team and find out what it's like to achieve your ultimate ambition - to lead your team to the top. Every decision you make will be crucial. Do you buy or sell a player, increase the gate money or go for broke with a massive bet? If you are nice to your bank manager, he may finance you, but for how long. Everything you need is in this program. Have you got what it takes to lead your team to the ultimate, the top of Division One?

213851.overview:
This is a Galaga-clone, where you have enemies coming inscreen from the left and right, to then go towards the top to form a grid, But while they are flying into position you can fire at them, and they can also fire back at you

Once they have flied into formation at the top of the screen, one at random will dart downwards firing bullets downwards in order to kill you, and if you collide with either the bullets or the enemy itself, you will perish and it will cost you a life

You also get the occasional drop from the enemies, such as Double Ship which makes your Ship twice as long, But it also gives you 2 Bullets to fire at once, which can help or sometimes hinder you, due to the extra length of your Ship

213852.overview: An Open Source, fast and fun blitz blaster. Simple to start but dangerously addictive. Destroy as many of the invading aliens as possible. Get as high a score as you can and have fun. Created in Blitz 2.1 by David Christian. Blast all the alien scum in this single screen shooter, get powerups to upgrade your gun! You can move all around the screen, not just left and right.

213853.overview: The object of the game is to score 10,000 points by throwing the dice. After each throw  you must choose to save a least one die. This increases your Temp Score. If you have no legal throw then this is a Wipeout and the next player gets their turn. If you manage to save all the dices then you have Blitz and can trow all the dice again. After each save you will be asked if you want to Twist or Stick. If you Stick your Temp Score is added to your Total Score but if you Wipeout then you lose the Temp Score.

213854.overview: Giger Tetris is commercially released puzzle game based on the original Tetris by Alexey Pajitnov in 1984, this one created by Panic Production. It's a rather tenuous link to the artist, H.R.Giger as it only has the one Giger image in the background, So mostly it's Tetris... with some classical music playing.

213855.overview: The rules of this game are very simple: the aim of the game is (as well as having fun) to collect all the white things scattered in the labyrinth with your own car (the red one), until you get to a complete cleaning. It is clear that you will have to avoid any contact with the evil enemy cars (green!) At all costs, otherwise you will lose a life.

213856.overview:
Released in a two game pack along with Cribbage King, this card game created by Anne Westfall & Mirage Graphics, Inc and released by The Software Toolworks is a topdown-view card game for up to 4 players. It is based on 1989 Software Toolworks PC/Tandy release. The original Amiga release package includes a Cribbage board and a deck of Bicycle cards.  
 
Play Gin like a master! Gin King will astound you. Gin King brings you the fascination of playing one of the world's most popular card games: challenging play, great graphics and a real sense of fun. Gin Kin's brilliance comes from the Artificial Intelligence labs that created the best-selling Chessmaster 2100 and Mavis Beacon Teaches Typing. Powered by the most advanced gin algorithms available. Gin King employs modern play techniques and sophisticated probability analysis. Adding to the sense of realism are stunning full-color, high resolution graphics incorporating traditional Bicycle card designs. Gin King even lets you choose your opponents from seven computer personalities. They can play against you or give you hints. Includes context sensitive help and easy to use, menu driven features to satisfy even the most demanding Gin enthusiast. With Gin King, you get the royal treatment!

213857.overview: Navigate the maze, use the switches to open passages, avoid the spectres and catch the green Gobblie. You only have three lives so be careful!

213858.overview: A one or two player, top down go-kart racing game created by Tony Philipsson and released as a cover disk by JumpDisk. You will have a total of four racers regardless of if you choose a 1 or 2 player game and the racing AI is primitive but can definitely be challenging at the start of the race.

213859.overview: A loderunner clone by Olaf Otterbach for one or two players with basic presentation but good play, came packaged with a level editor. When you have gathered the gold nuggets you can take the gold ladder out. Dig holes to trap enemies as you cannot jump.

213860.overview:
Go-Moku is a single player, mouse controlled adaptation of the traditional board game Go-Moku.

The player plays against the computer with both trying to be the first to have five stones/tokens in a row horizontally, vertically and diagonally on a 19x19 board. The human player always starts.

213861.overview: Go Player is a computer adaption of the old board game Go which is most often played in Eastern Asia. The basic principle is that two players (one white, the other black) place stones on a 19x19 board. The goal is to control as big as possible areas on the board by circling it with own stones. Likewise, enemy stones can be taken out of the game by circling them. At the end of the match (when both players pass their turn) the size of controlled areas and the taken out stones determine the winner. This game features two smaller boards (9x9 and 13x13) and handicap options, both adapted from real-life rule adaptions. There are also 101 difficulty levels and the option to pre-define the board to practice special match situations.

213862.overview: The Evil Gorfian Robot Empire has attacked. Your assignment is to repel the invasion and launch a confrontation. You will engage various hostile space craft as you journey towards a dramatic confrontation with the enemy flagship. This Gorf remake was created by Kevin Gallagher several versions were released over time, primarily in 1993. One version of the game is available on the 2nd coverdisk of Amiga Action 67.

213863.overview:
A Digital Ninja Christmas Special! A Christmas game for 2 to 4 players by Lee Bamber and released in 1994. This is not a violent game, nor is it horrific, terrifying, obscene, shocking or sickening. It's a game of the mind. If you are easily offended, the kids being sliced apart, crushed, kicked, thrown, maimed, stabbed and murdered are mere actors, playing a well-performed scene for your enjoyment. To the rest of us, it's a chance to release all those daily seasonal tensions. And for the minority who have no worries, it's a fast-paced, sadistic blood riot!  

Collect the grisly presents that Santa drops...and you can only hold 1 at a time...so you auto drop the one were holding when you pick up a new one. And know that Santa doesn't always drop the same pressies every round, so just keep collecting presents until you get the one you wanted.

213864.overview: A German language card game for up to 3 players, it is a sequel to Grand Ouvert and was created by Manfred Leidorf and  Peter W. H. Arnold. As before, only only children are allowed to play skat, but solo gamblers are now offered three different gaming tables and two decks of cards (German/French). Also new are three levels of difficulty, so that even the experienced card knocker can find suitable players. Now quickly set whether Kontra/Re is allowed to be played and the CPU distributes the hands.

213865.overview: Gravity Wars is a turn-based artillery game for the Amiga and PC originally written by Ed Bartz in 1987. Unlike the first artillery games, Gravity Wars has 2D gravity from planets. The game consists of two spaceships firing projectiles at each other using an angle and velocity. Randomly scattered planets across a 2D system gravitationally attracting the projectiles make shots tricky, with the shots describing chaotic paths. The player's enjoyment is derived from the skill required to achieve a successful hit and the surprising orbits resulting from shots that can result in unexpected own goals. With its simplicity and aesthetic beauty it inspired re-makes with the same name.

213866.overview: A British, 3 reel slot\fruit machine game for one player, but with many, many features common to video poker at the time of the 1993 release. If you need some flashing button fun, this has all the excitement without the old pub smell.

213867.overview: Clever Carusoe must collect all the gold from each of the four levels. Once he picks up a piece of gold he must get back to his home before the time runs out. He can only carry one piece of gold at a time. The guards will speed up and try to chase Carusoe when he picks up the gold. Avoid the guards or he will lose a life. Watch the time, you don't have forever!

213868.overview: One of the very first REAL Nintendo conversions for the Amiga 1200, this recreation of the classic game and watch handheld game. The player controls a bug exterminator only referred to as the "Fumigator" in the manual, and the objective is to spray worms and spiders that try to eat the flowers in a greenhouse. The worms crawl along vines on the top screen, while the spiders crawl along webs on the bottom screen, and the player will have to try to hit them with a spray before they reach the flowers (which would then die, giving the player a miss). The spiders are a little more difficult to defeat, as they are killed only when sprayed closest to a flower (they simply back away when sprayed farther away). The game is a two-level one with a ladder connecting the two parts (which otherwise offer almost identical action).

213887.overview: This is my version of the C64 oldie "Crossfire". Your task is to survive as long as possible in the arena which is surrounded by enemies who shoot at you. You can move the ship with the Joystick in Port2 as long as you stay inside the arena. Pressing the fire button and moving the joystick in a direction will fire a bullet in that direction, assuming you haven't run out of ammo yet.

213890.overview:
Greenies is an arena-style fight to the death for up to three players (human or computer). Assume the role of an ogre a troll or a goblin and take apart the other players in an attempt to be the last man standing. The larger characters have more health and muscle power, whilst the smaller characters are faster and can carry more items – the choice is up to you.

The action takes place in a maze filled with all sorts of nasty weapons including grenades, rockets, chainsaws, baseball bats, TNT, mines, rocket launchers and magic potions.

There is also a one-player adventure mode in which you go up against computer controlled Greenies as a knight character. In this more puzzle-oriented mode you must find the treasure on 25 different levels and reach the exit alive in order to complete the game.

213891.overview:
A freeware title from Mario Speranda, in this game two adversaries are in the desert, each with only 3 cacti to protect them from the rain bullets being traded between the two. Can you use your cover more effectively, or will your friend\frenemy be a better shot? It is almost High Noon, so you had better hope you're a better marksman. 
 
Players of a certain age will recognize the inspiration behind Gringos: an ancient arcade game called Boot Hill (or the even older Gun Fight). Cowboy on the left, cowboy on the right, cacti or other objects between them and a stagecoach whizzing periodically up the middle. Thus assembled, what do the two cow-gentlemen in our little scene do? Shoot at each other, of course! A shot to the belly kills instantly, but a shot to the leg merely wounds: the wounded player can then only move half as fast (a tragic spectacle) but can still win. It's a very satisfying thing, actually, hobbling around on one leg and still managing to nail that flea-bitten varmint on the other side.

213892.overview: The sequel to the popular Formula1 racing game played in a third person perspective in the mold of Pole Position. the game consists of tracks based on real world locations and this disk has more of those to experience. These can be played in a competition consisting of three laps or in a practice mode with 99 laps (or until the player presses the escape key). In each race there are 23 AI controlled cars to compete against. The game is playable in three difficulties: novice, amateur and professional. The car has six gears that have to be changed manually and a boost feature can also be used for faster acceleration.

213904.overview: Grotto Mines 2 is a Boulder Dash clone made by Pistol of Australia in 1993 and expanded and adapted by No One based on Emerald Mine.

213905.overview: The Wormy's back! The master blaster of the United Worm Federation is here to blast, grab power ups and blast even BETTER! Created by Les Wigmore and Daniel Owen aka Wigsoft this shooter has the red battling the other color worms for universal dominance.

213906.overview: Global Thermonuclear Warfare is a turn-based game of nuclear war, with gameplay elements of classic games Duck Shoot and Tanks. Choose a unit, a nuclear silo or submarine, and set the angle and range. Players take turns to destroy the other side. Mark Sheeky noted, "This was my 13th Amiga game. I remade this game twice for PC, as Thermonuclear Domination (1999) (which is also here on itch), and a 3D version called Radioactive, which was released in 2001 and updated continually, finally being remastered and released on Steam in 2019." The game was later, eventually released as freeware.

213907.overview: Gunnygo! is a platforming game created by Bernd Schwarzmann and released in 1993 featuring 3 levels of difficulty and the full version has 30 levels of fun! Full version contains 2 universal level editors. Collect the coins and hearts, avoid the baddies like the sliders and your constant flying foe who follows ferociously.

213908.overview:
A one or two player card game using Tarot cards. Each pack of cards has 40 cards, 10 for each suit, the suits are Gold (coins), Cups, Clubs and Spades (swords) and are numbered 1,2,3,4,5,6,7,10,11 and 12 (there are no 8's or 9's). Only 1,3,10, 11 and 12 are worth points (Briscas). 1=11 points, 3=10 points, 10=2 points, 11=3 points and 12=4 points. There are 120 points total available, if each player gets 60 it will be a tie. After dealing one card is dealt face up and this card represents LIFE and the rest of the un-dealt cards are face down next to LIFE. At each turn, a card is played and the other player tries to KILL that card. The one that kills keeps the pair. Players keep 3 cards in their hand, drawing to keep that level.  
 
LIFE kills all cards except another LIFE of a higher value. 3 of LIFE kills a 12 of LIFE, but a 12 of LIFE kills any other suit. You can kill a card with a higher number of the same suit. Modem play was available.

213930.overview: You are a mouse and there is cheese to be had, unfortunately peril comes along with it in this platformer game created by Andreas Günther in 1991.

213974.overview: The Golden Pyramid is a Puzzle game, developed by Paul D. Obie and published by Micro Entertainment, which was released in 1987.

214923.overview:
